snippet.title: No Way Home: BLAMMO! A tactical arcade roguelite! Coming to Steam Early Access 202X
snippet.description:
SMG Studio is excited to announce No Way Home: BLAMMO!, a brand-new tactical arcade roguelite. BLAMMO! Is all about fast-paced twin stick space combat. Creative upgrade builds let you battle your way.

BLAM! the Wishlist and Follow button on Steam now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3246120/No_Way_Home_BLAMMO/

So if you like shmups then this will scratch the itch!

We'll be developing this game openly with the community!

Stay up to date with everything SMG by following us across the internet 🔽

TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@smgstudio
